data.name: customSqlQuery1.Sql
data.value: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.PONbr, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS PONbr , CONVERT(VARCHAR, PurchOrd.PODate, 6) AS PODate , PurchOrd.VendName + Salut AS VendName , Vendor.Attn AS VendAttn , Vendor.Addr1 AS VendAddr1 , Vendor.Addr2 AS VendAddr2 , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Vendor.City, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS VendCity , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Vendor.Phone, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS VendPhone , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Vendor.Fax, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS VendFax , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipName, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipName , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipAddr1, CHAR(160), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipAddr1 , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipAddr2, CHAR(160), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipAddr2 , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipCity, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipCity , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipState, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipState , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipZip, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipZip , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.ShipCountry, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS ShipCountry , Country1.Descr AS Negara , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.Terms, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS Terms , POSetup.BillName , POSetup.BillAttn , POSetup.BillAddr1 , POSetup.BillAddr2 , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(POSetup.BillCity, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS BillCity , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(POSetup.BillState, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS BillState , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(POSetup.BillZip, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS BillZip , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(POSetup.BillCountry, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS BillCountry , POSetup.BillPhone , POSetup.BillFax , PurOrdDet.CuryID , PurchOrd.User5 , Country2.Descr AS Negara2 , ISNULL(curry.Terbilang, '') AS Terbilang , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.TaxID00, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS Tax , ( SELECT TOP 1 TaxRate FROM TSC26Application.dbo.SalesTax WHERE TaxId = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.TaxID00, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) ) AS Taxf , LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PurchOrd.Note, CHAR(10), CHAR(32)), CHAR(13), CHAR(32)), CHAR(160), CHAR(32)), CHAR(9), CHAR(32)))) AS Note FROM ( PurOrdDet WITH ( NOLOCK ) INNER JOIN PurchOrd WITH ( NOLOCK ) ON PurchOrd.PONbr = PurOrdDet.PONbr INNER JOIN TSC26Application.dbo.Country AS Country1 ON PurchOrd.ShipCountry = Country1.CountryID LEFT JOIN Curry ON PurchOrd.CuryID = curry.CurryID ) INNER JOIN TSC26Application.dbo.VENDOR WITH ( NOLOCK ) ON Vendor.VendID = PurchOrd.VendID , TSC26Application.dbo.POSetup WITH ( NOLOCK ) INNER JOIN TSC26Application.dbo.Country AS Country2 ON POSetup.BillCountry = Country2.CountryID WHERE PurchOrd.PONbr = @PONumber;

data.name: customSqlQuery2.Sql
data.value: SELECT a.[level] AS Kol , CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.Username, '') = '' THEN a.user_id ELSE b.Name END AS UserName , a.status AS Status , CONVERT(VARCHAR, a.tanggal, 6) AS Tanggal FROM dbo.approvalpo AS a LEFT JOIN dbo.S_User AS b ON a.user_id = b.Username WHERE a.PONbr = @PONumber and a.[level]=1;
